title: MPNdpoint. Single-center, Retrospective, Prospective Study of the Outcome of Patients With Philadelphia-negative Chronic Myeloproliferative Neoplasms
official: MPNdpoint. Single-center, Retrospective, Prospective Study of the Outcome of Patients With Philadelphia-negative Chronic Myeloproliferative Neoplasms
summary: Chronic myeloproliferative neoplasms (MPNs) are hematologic disorders of the myeloid lineage characterized by clonal proliferation of hematopoietic stem cells, high risk of thrombotic-hemorrhagic complications, and transformation into secondary acute myeloid leukemia. MPNs include: myelofibrosis, polycythemia vera, and essential thrombocythemia. The low incidence, comparable to that of rare diseases, induces the in-depth study of patients and thus the need to develop a project with databases to collect clinical, biological, and therapeutic information.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Patients 16 years of age and older
* Patients diagnosed with polycythemia vera, essential thrombocythemia, prefibrotic and overt primary myelofibrosis, secondary myelofibrosis (Arber et al, Blood 2022 or earlier but reclassified classifications)

Exclusion Criteria:

* Patients with diagnosis other than polycythemia vera, essential thrombocythemia, prefibrotic and overt primary myelofibrosis, secondary myelofibrosis
* Follow up of less than 6 months
